{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders (exclude refunded)
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                        (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Verify no QA orders are present (should be 0)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
qa_in_loyal_completed = len(qa_orders[qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'])

# Check for refunded orders in the LOYAL completed set
refunded_loyal = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                       (sales['status'] == 'refunded')]
refunded_in_loyal_completed = len(refunded_loyal)

# Calculate mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print results
print(f'QA orders in LOYAL completed: {qa_in_loyal_completed}')
print(f'Refunded orders in LOYAL completed: {refunded_in_loyal_completed}')
print(f'Mean revenue of completed LOYAL orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
